notes.title: KIRAKIRA SLIMES FULL GAME IS OUT NOW!
notes.notes:
I still can’t believe I’m finally writing these words. After approximately 2 years of work, [b]Kirakira Slimes[/b] is finally seeing the light.

The development process has been full of ups and downs, challenges, and lessons, but also beautiful moments that motivated us to keep going. Despite everything, we’ve managed to bring this project to a close, and we couldn’t be prouder of the result. I’m deeply grateful to the team and to everyone who believed in this idea from the very beginning.

I won’t keep you here too long, because what matters now is [b]that you play the game!!!!![/b]

Thank you for joining us on this journey. 💖

notes.title: KIRAKIRA SLIMES EARLY ACCESS IS OUT NOW!
notes.notes:
[h2]We did it, the Kirakira Slimes Early Access is officially available for you <3 ⋆✦ ⊹ ࣪ ˖  (๑ > ᴗ < ๑)[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44990061/cb43d5ecb37e065fec607d4f86a92e426ca296d4.png[/img]

We are very happy to finally be able to release the first version of our game, and we can't wait for you all to try it out and give us your feedback.

During these weeks, we will be making updates and improvements regarding the local multiplayer version and the ranking system. 

We have in mind to upload a roadmap, so you can be aware of how the early access will evolve compared to the idea of the final version of the game we have in mind, so stay tuned to our social networks and steam page.

Thanks for your support and see you next time.

notes.title: EARLY ACCESS RELASE DATE ANNOUNCEMENT: MAY 10 2024
notes.notes:
[b]Kirakira Slimes[/b] is officially releasing on May 10. Tell all your friends and family that in one week the game will be available for you all - SPREAD THE WORD.

We made a trailer not to only announce the release date, but to show the first video gameplay of Kirakira Slimes.

If you haven't seen the trailer. you can check it out [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9p_xAUF8hFQ ]HERE[/url]
